stories.title: Franklin County students shaping conversations around artificial intelligence
stories.simple_summary: Students in Franklin County are learning about artificial intelligence and discussing how it works and affects society.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about education. If you have grandchildren, they're probably learning about AI in school, so understanding the basics helps you talk with them about it.

stories.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's top security officer left quietly last summer. Now the company's CEO has stepped down due to personal relationships, and experts worry the security team missed warning signs about sensitive information leaking.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and Nvidia employees. For ordinary people, it shows why big companies need strong security, but it doesn't directly affect your daily life.

stories.title: Artificial Intelligence: Why are traditional industries adopting it?
stories.simple_summary: Traditional businesses like factories, farms, and stores are starting to use artificial intelligence in their work.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a small business, this shows that AI tools are becoming part of how many industries operate. You may hear more about it or be asked about it by customers or competitors.

stories.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
stories.simple_summary: More than 115,000 people signed a petition asking Nvidia to rehire its CEO Jensen Huang after he stepped down.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about what investors and tech insiders think. There's nothing you need to do about it.

stories.title: How criminals are using AI to abuse kids
stories.simple_summary: Criminals are using artificial intelligence tools to harm children in illegal ways.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters because parents and grandparents should know this happens. Teaching kids to be careful online and talk to trusted adults about uncomfortable interactions is more important than ever.

stories.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
stories.simple_summary: Many artificial intelligence projects and startups have failed or shut down, including Apple's Siri updates and OpenAI's new app launch.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that not every AI tool succeeds. Some companies promise great things but don't deliver, so it's smart to wait and see if new AI products actually work before trusting them.

stories.title: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit
stories.simple_summary: Governments in Asia are checking whether they can still get computer chips from Nvidia after the CEO's departure, and some are investigating related problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to governments and large companies. It could eventually affect prices of electronics, but there's nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: AI Tools Huang Championed Now Star in Memes of His Downfall
stories.simple_summary: People on the internet are making jokes and memes about Nvidia's CEO using the AI tools he promoted.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just internet humor and doesn't affect you. It matters only to people who follow tech news and social media closely.

stories.title: The OpenAI board member who fired Sam Altman says we still can’t trust AI CEOs
stories.simple_summary: A board member who made the decision to fire OpenAI's CEO says AI company leaders still cannot be fully trusted to run their businesses properly.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about how AI companies should be managed and governed. It matters if you're concerned about whether AI companies are trustworthy, but most small business owners don't need to worry about it.

stories.title: Jensen Huang and the decline of the visionary showman founder CEO
stories.simple_summary: This is about the history of Nvidia's CEO and his style as a company leader who puts on big shows for fans and investors.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a story about business leadership style and celebrity culture in the tech world. There's nothing you need to do about it.

stories.title: New awards show celebrates AI music and its creators
stories.simple_summary: A new awards show is celebrating music made by artificial intelligence and the people who created it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you enjoy music or know musicians, you might see AI-made music become more common. This shows that AI is now part of entertainment, but you can always choose to listen to music made by people instead.

stories.title: Does the Trump Administration’s Campaign to Rebrand AI as ‘Super Intelligence’ Matter?
stories.simple_summary: The Trump administration is trying to change the name from 'artificial intelligence' to 'super intelligence' in its public messaging.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about political branding and communication strategy. What we call AI doesn't change what it actually does, so this matters very little to you in practical terms.
